estimates.assumptions: Pure sunflower oil; consistent with previous 28 g total assumption. No carbohydrates.
1 medium onion (110 g) chopped; consistent with previous assumption. Raw onion: ~9.2 g carbs and 1.7 g fiber per 100 g.
1 average garlic clove (3 g) peeled and crushed; consistent with previous assumption. Garlic: ~33 g carbs and ~2 g fiber per 100 g.
400 g can chickpeas, using ~250 g drained weight consistent with previous assumption (121 kcal/100 g drained). Drained chickpeas: ~16.4 g carbs and 5 g fiber per 100 g.
1 tsp (2 g) ground cumin; consistent with previous assumption. Spices: ~40 g carbs and 30 g fiber per 100 g.
1 tsp (2 g) ground coriander; consistent with previous assumption. Spices: ~50 g carbs and 40 g fiber per 100 g (approx.).
Handful fresh parsley assumed as 10 g chopped; consistent with previous assumption. Fresh parsley: ~14 g carbs and 7 g fiber per 100 g (raw).
1 large egg (50 g edible portion) beaten; consistent with previous assumption. Whole egg has negligible carbohydrates.
